prompt: Turn these original notes into a short reflective passage: 'Kept an old coat for years. Too small now. Found a cinema ticket in the pocket. Remembered the friend, not the film. Put the ticket in a drawer and donated the coat.' Please answer in roughly 80 words.
text: I had kept the old coat for years, though it no longer fit. While emptying its pockets, I found a faded cinema ticket and was surprised that I could not remember the film at all. What returned instead was the friend beside me—their laughter, our conversation afterward, the feeling of being young and unhurried. I slipped the ticket into a drawer, unwilling to lose that small doorway to the past, and donated the coat. Some memories need less space than others.
